paper.title_en: Universality classes, Thermodynamics of Group Entropies, and Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: Conventional Boltzmann--Gibbs statistical mechanics successfully describes systems with weak to moderate correlations, in which the number of accessible configurations $W(N)$ grows exponentially with the number of degrees of freedom $N$. However, this framework breaks down for systems for which the effectively occupied configuration space exhibits non-exponential growth. While numerous generalized entropies have been proposed to address this limitation, a coherent link to classical thermodynamic laws has remained elusive. Here, we propose group entropies as a unifying framework, defining universality classes of entropies through the asymptotic scaling of $W(N)$, each yielding an extensive entropy. We show that this approach provides the basis for a consistent thermodynamic formulation beyond the Boltzmann--Gibbs paradigm. In particular, by expressing these entropies in terms of thermodynamic state variables, we demonstrate their consistency with classical thermodynamics, in close analogy to the emergence of the Clausius entropy from the Boltzmann--Gibbs formalism. Focusing on the zeroth thermodynamic law, we identify the empirical temperature and, by using Carathéodory's formulation of the second law, we derive the associated absolute temperature. As an application, we analyse black-hole thermodynamics using the extensive group entropy class corresponding to stretched-exponential behaviour of $W(N)$ and derive a negative heat capacity, known to be a hallmark property of black holes. This result holds for the stretched-exponential entropies associated with both the Bekenstein--Hawking and Barrow entropy scalings.

decision.title_zh: 普适类、群熵的热力学与黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 传统的Boltzmann--Gibbs统计力学成功描述了具有弱至中等关联的系统，其中可及构型数$W(N)$随自由度数$N$指数增长。然而，对于有效占据的构型空间呈现非指数增长的系统，该框架失效。尽管为应对这一局限已提出众多广义熵，但其与经典热力学定律之间的连贯联系仍难以建立。在此，我们提出以群熵作为统一框架，通过$W(N)$的渐近标度行为定义熵的普适类，每一类都给出一个广延熵。我们表明，这一方法为超越Boltzmann--Gibbs范式的自洽热力学表述提供了基础。特别地，通过将这些熵用热力学状态变量表示，我们证明它们与经典热力学相一致，这与Clausius熵从Boltzmann--Gibbs形式中涌现的情形密切相关。聚焦于热力学第零定律，我们识别出经验温度，并利用Carathéodory对第二定律的表述，推导出相应的绝对温度。作为应用，我们使用对应于$W(N)$拉伸指数行为的广延群熵类分析黑洞热力学，并推导出负热容——这被认为是黑洞的标志性性质。该结果对于与Bekenstein--Hawking熵标度和Barrow熵标度相关的拉伸指数熵均成立。
